items.title: 14.3.7 Real World Applications on Cross or Vector Product (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab tak cross product ka hisaab seekha. Is aakhri sabaq mein dekhenge ke yeh asal duniya mein kahan kaam aata hai: zameen ke tukre ka area, kisi shakal ka area, aur ghumane wali force ka asar (moment). Cross product ki lambai area deti hai, aur us ki direction batati hai ke cheez kis axis par ghoomegi.
(a) Area of Parallelogram

Agar \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) do non-zero vectors hon aur un ke darmiyan angle \(\theta\) ho, to \(|\underline{u}|\) aur \(|\underline{v}|\) ek parallelogram ki do saath wali (adjacent) sides ki lambaiyan hain (figure dekhiye). Hum jaante hain ke

\[\text{Area of parallelogram} = \text{Base} \times \text{Height}\]
\[= (\text{Base})(h) = |\underline{u}||\underline{v}|\sin\theta\]
\[\therefore\; \text{Area of parallelogram} = |\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|\]

blocks.alt: Parallelogram with vectors u and v from a common corner, angle theta between them. A dashed perpendicular from the tip of u to v has length h = |u| sin theta. Sides |u| and |v| are labelled.
blocks.caption: Figure: parallelogram on u and v with height h = |u| sin θ (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(h = |\underline{u}|\sin\theta\) kyun? \(\underline{u}\) ki nok se base \(\underline{v}\) par seedhi (perpendicular) line giraiye; yahi height \(h\) hai. Ab ek right triangle bana jis ka hypotenuse \(|\underline{u}|\) hai aur \(h\) angle \(\theta\) ke saamne hai. Trigonometry: \(\sin\theta = \frac{\text{saamne wali side}}{\text{hypotenuse}} = h/|\underline{u}|\), to \(h = |\underline{u}|\sin\theta\).
Base \(|\underline{v}|\) hai, to area \(= |\underline{v}| \cdot |\underline{u}|\sin\theta\), jo bilkul \(|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|\) hai. Yani cross product ki lambai hi parallelogram ka area hai. Kitni khoobsurat baat!
(b) Area of Triangle

Figure se saaf hai ke diagonal parallelogram ko do barabar triangles mein baant deta hai, is liye
\[\text{Area of triangle} = \tfrac{1}{2}(\text{Area of parallelogram})\]
\[\text{Area of triangle} = \tfrac{1}{2}|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|\]
jahan \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) triangle ki do saath wali sides ke saath vectors hain.

blocks.alt: Vectors u and v from a common corner with angle theta; the parallelogram on them is completed with dashed lines and a dashed diagonal cuts it into two equal triangles; the triangle on u and v is shaded.
blocks.caption: Figure: the triangle on u and v is half of the parallelogram (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Agar triangle ke teen kone \(A, B, C\) diye hon, to ek hi kone se do sides lijiye, jaise \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{AC}\); phir area \(= \tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}|\). Parallelogram mein yaqeen kar lijiye ke dono vectors saath wali sides hain, ek side aur ek diagonal nahin. Is ka tareeqa: chauthe kone ko check kijiye (Example 20 mein dekhiye).
Ab kitab ki do misaalein: pehli parallelogram ki, doosri triangle ki.

blocks.title: Example 20
blocks.problem: Find area of the parallelogram whose vertices are \(P(0, 0, 0)\), \(Q(-1, 2, 4)\), \(R(2, -1, 4)\) and \(S(1, 1, 8)\).
steps:
Given: \(P(0, 0, 0)\), \(Q(-1, 2, 4)\), \(R(2, -1, 4)\), \(S(1, 1, 8)\).
To find: parallelogram \(PQRS\) ka area.
Method: area \(= |\overrightarrow{PQ} \times \overrightarrow{PR}|\), jahan \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{PR}\) adjacent (saath wale) sides hain. Pehle tasdeeq: \(Q + R - P = (1, 1, 8) = S\), yani \(S\) point \(P\) ke aamne saamne hai aur \(PQ\), \(PR\) waqai adjacent sides hain.

Step 1: Side vectors
\[\overrightarrow{PQ} = (-1 - 0)\underline{i} + (2 - 0)\underline{j} + (4 - 0)\underline{k}\]
\[= -\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{PR} = (2 - 0)\underline{i} + (-1 - 0)\underline{j} + (4 - 0)\underline{k}\]
\[= 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\overrightarrow{PQ} = \overrightarrow{OQ} - \overrightarrow{OP}\): aakhri point minus shuru ka point.

Step 3: Area
\[|12\underline{i} + 12\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}| = \sqrt{144 + 144 + 9}\]
\[= \sqrt{297} = 3\sqrt{33}\]
Kyun: area cross product ki lambai hai. \(297 = 9 \times 33\), is liye \(\sqrt{297} = 3\sqrt{33} \approx 17.23\).

Tasdeeq:
\[(12, 12, -3) \cdot (-1, 2, 4) = -12 + 24 - 12 = 0\]
\[(12, 12, -3) \cdot (2, -1, 4) = 24 - 12 - 12 = 0\]
Cross product dono sides par perpendicular hai, to hisaab sahi.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Parallelogram ke sawal mein sab se pehle yeh pakka kijiye ke kaun se do vectors saath wali sides hain. Chaar kone \(P, Q, R, S\) diye hon to zaroori nahin ke \(PQ\) aur \(PR\) hi sides hon; kabhi \(PR\) diagonal bhi ho sakta hai. Aasan test: jo kona \(P\) ke aamne saamne hai woh \(Q + R - P\) ke barabar hona chahiye. Yahan \(Q + R - P = (1, 1, 8) = S\), to \(PQ\) aur \(PR\) waqai sides hain. Agar diagonal le lete to area ghalat aata.

Ab triangle wali misaal. Yahan bhi wahi tareeqa hai, bas aakhir mein aadha karna hai. Saath hi plane par perpendicular unit vector bhi maanga gaya hai; woh bhi isi cross product se mil jayega, bilkul Example 16 ki tarah. Ek hisaab, do jawab.

blocks.title: Example 21
blocks.problem: Find the area of the triangle with vertices \(A(1, -1, 1)\), \(B(2, 1, -1)\) and \(C(-1, 1, 2)\). Also find a unit vector perpendicular to the plane of triangle \(ABC\).
steps:
Given: \(A(1, -1, 1)\), \(B(2, 1, -1)\), \(C(-1, 1, 2)\).
To find: triangle \(ABC\) ka area, aur us ke plane par perpendicular unit vector.
Method: \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) do adjacent sides hain. Area \(= \tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}|\), aur \(\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}\) plane par perpendicular hai; use lambai se divide karein to unit vector.

Step 1: Side vectors
\[\overrightarrow{AB} = (2 - 1)\underline{i} + (1 + 1)\underline{j} + (-1 - 1)\underline{k}\]
\[= \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{AC} = (-1 - 1)\underline{i} + (1 + 1)\underline{j} + (2 - 1)\underline{k}\]
\[= -2\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\]
Kyun: aakhri point minus shuru ka point; \(1 - (-1) = 1 + 1\).

Step 3: Parallelogram ka area
\[|6\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}| = \sqrt{36 + 9 + 36}\]
\[= \sqrt{81} = 9\]
Kyun: yeh parallelogram ka area hai; triangle us ka aadha hai.

Step 4: Triangle ka area
\[\tfrac12|\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}| = \tfrac{9}{2}\]
Kyun: diagonal parallelogram ko do barabar triangles mein baant deta hai.

Step 5: Unit vector
\[\dfrac{\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}}{|\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AC}|} = \dfrac{1}{9}(6\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + 6\underline{k})\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{3}(2\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 2\underline{k})\]
Kyun: vector ko us ki lambai 9 se divide kiya; phir 3 common nikaala.

Tasdeeq:
\[\tfrac13(2 + 2 - 4) = 0,\quad \tfrac13(-4 + 2 + 2) = 0\]
\[\tfrac13\sqrt{4 + 1 + 4} = 1\]
Dot products \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) ke saath zero, aur lambai 1. Ulta vector \(-\tfrac13(2\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 2\underline{k})\) bhi sahi jawab hai.
blocks.answer: Area \(= \frac{9}{2}\) square units; unit vector \(\frac13(2\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 2\underline{k})\) (ya is ka ulta).

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Triangle ke sawal mein dono side vectors ek hi kone se nikalne chahiye, jaise \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) dono \(A\) se. Agar ek \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur doosra \(\overrightarrow{CA}\) le lein to bhi lambai wahi aati hai, lekin aadat yahi daaliye ke dono ek kone se hon, taa ke ghalti ka imkaan na rahe. Aur \(\tfrac12\) kabhi mat bhooliye: triangle parallelogram ka aadha hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 21 mein kitab ke andar vertex \(B\) ke coordinates kharab (dhundle) chhape hain; kitab ka apna hal \(B(2, 1, -1)\) istemal karta hai, wahi humne liya. Aakhri line mein barabar ke nishan minus jaise chhape hain; sahi nateeja \(\frac{1}{9}(6\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}) = \frac{1}{3}(2\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 2\underline{k})\) hai.
(c) Moment of Force

Maan lijiye ek force \(\underline{F}\,(\overrightarrow{PQ})\) point \(P\) par lag rahi hai, jaise figure mein. To \(O\) ke gird \(\underline{F}\) ka moment:
= force \(\underline{F}\) ki magnitude × \(O\) se force ki line tak perpendicular faasla \(ON\), aur direction \(\underline{n}\) ki taraf
\[= (PQ)(ON)(\underline{n})\]
\[= (PQ)(OP)\sin\theta\,(\underline{n})\]
\[= \overrightarrow{OP} \times \overrightarrow{PQ} = \underline{r} \times \underline{F}\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein yeh line ulajh kar chhapi hai ('perpendicular ON the direction of n'). Sahi matlab yeh hai: \(O\) ke gird moment = force ki magnitude × \(O\) se force ki line tak perpendicular faasla \(ON\), aur direction unit vector \(\underline{n}\) ki taraf. Upar humne saaf likh diya hai.

blocks.alt: Point O above a horizontal line through N, P and Q. ON is a dashed perpendicular from O to the line. Vector r runs from O to P; the force F acts along PQ. The angle theta is marked at P between PQ and the extension of r, and again between PN and PO. The vector r cross F is drawn from O, perpendicular to the plane of r and F.
blocks.caption: Figure: moment of the force F about O, with r = OP and ON perpendicular to the line of action (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(ON = OP\sin\theta\) kyun? Triangle \(ONP\) mein \(N\) par right angle hai. \(P\) par \(PO\) aur \(PN\) ke darmiyan angle bhi \(\theta\) hai (yeh \(\underline{r}\) ki lambi ki hui line aur \(\underline{F}\) ke angle ke aamne saamne wala angle hai). Is liye \(\sin\theta = ON/OP\).
Rozmarra ki misaal: darwaza kabze (hinge) se door dhakelein to aasani se khulta hai, qareeb dhakelein to mushkil. Wajah yahi faasla \(ON\) hai: moment = force × perpendicular faasla. Physics mein ise torque kehte hain, aur \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) us ki direction bhi deta hai, yani kis axis par ghoomega.
Tarteeb ahem hai: moment \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) hai, aur \(\underline{r}\) point \(O\) se force ki line ki taraf jata hai.
Ab kitab ki misaal mein moment nikalte hain.

blocks.title: Example 22
blocks.problem: Find the moment about the point \(M(-2, 4, -6)\) of the force represented by \(\overrightarrow{AB}\), where coordinates of points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((1, 2, -3)\) and \((3, -4, 2)\) respectively.
steps:
Given: \(M(-2, 4, -6)\), \(A(1, 2, -3)\), \(B(3, -4, 2)\); force \(\overrightarrow{AB}\).
To find: \(M\) ke gird force ka moment aur us ki magnitude.
Method: moment \(= \underline{r} \times \underline{F}\), jahan \(\underline{F} = \overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\underline{r}\) point \(M\) se force ki line par kisi point tak ka vector hai; \(A\) us line par hai, to \(\underline{r} = \overrightarrow{MA}\).

Step 2: Position vector \(\underline{r}\)
\[\overrightarrow{MA} = (1 + 2)\underline{i} + (2 - 4)\underline{j} + (-3 + 6)\underline{k}\]
\[= 3\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(A\) minus \(M\); minus ko minus se plus, jaise \(1 - (-2) = 3\).

Step 3: Moment
\[\underline{r} \times \underline{F} = \overrightarrow{MA} \times \overrightarrow{AB}\]
\[= \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 3 & -2 & 3 \\ 2 & -6 & 5 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (-10 + 18)\underline{i} - (15 - 6)\underline{j} + (-18 + 4)\underline{k}\]
\[= 8\underline{i} - 9\underline{j} - 14\underline{k}\]
Kyun: tarteeb \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) hai, is liye \(\overrightarrow{MA}\) row 2 mein. \(\underline{i}\): \((-2)(5) - 3(-6) = 8\); \(\underline{j}\): \(-(3 \cdot 5 - 3 \cdot 2) = -9\); \(\underline{k}\): \(3(-6) - (-2)(2) = -14\).

Step 4: Magnitude
\[|\underline{r} \times \underline{F}| = \sqrt{8^{2} + (-9)^{2} + (-14)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{64 + 81 + 196} = \sqrt{341}\]
Kyun: lambai ka formula.

Tasdeeq:
\[\overrightarrow{MB} = 5\underline{i} - 8\underline{j} + 8\underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{MB} \times \overrightarrow{AB} = 8\underline{i} - 9\underline{j} - 14\underline{k}\]
Line ka doosra point \(B\) lein to bhi wahi moment aaya. Wajah: \(\overrightarrow{MB} = \overrightarrow{MA} + \overrightarrow{AB}\), aur \(\overrightarrow{AB} \times \overrightarrow{AB} = \underline{0}\).

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Moment ke sawal mein \(\underline{r}\) ka matlab samajhna sab se zaroori hai. \(\underline{r}\) us point se shuru hota hai jis ke gird moment poocha gaya hai (yahan \(M\)), aur force ki line ke kisi bhi point par khatam hota hai (yahan \(A\)). Ulta le lein, yani \(A\) se \(M\), to har component ka sign ulat jayega. Aur tarteeb hamesha \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\): pehle \(\underline{r}\), phir \(\underline{F}\). Tasdeeq wale qadam ne dikhaya ke line ka koi bhi point lein, jawab wahi aata hai, kyun ke force ki line ke saath chalne se sirf \(\underline{F}\) ke parallel hissa barhta hai, jis ka \(\underline{F}\) ke saath cross product zero hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari misaal, kitab ka sawal nahin.) Ek force \(\underline{F} = 3\underline{j}\) point \(P(2, 0, 0)\) par lag rahi hai. Origin \(O\) ke gird moment: \(\underline{r} = 2\underline{i}\), to \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F} = 2\underline{i} \times 3\underline{j} = 6\underline{k}\).
Kyun: magnitude \(6 = 3 \times 2\), yani force × perpendicular faasla (force \(y\) ki taraf hai aur \(O\) se us ki line ka faasla 2 hai). Direction \(\underline{k}\): cheez \(z\)-axis ke gird anticlockwise ghoomegi.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari misaal, kitab ka sawal nahin.) Triangle ke kone \((0, 0, 0)\), \((2, 0, 0)\), \((0, 3, 0)\) hain. Sides \(2\underline{i}\) aur \(3\underline{j}\).
\(2\underline{i} \times 3\underline{j} = 6\underline{k}\), lambai 6, to area \(= \tfrac12 \cdot 6 = 3\).
Tasdeeq: yeh right triangle hai jis ka base 2 aur height 3 hai: \(\tfrac12 \cdot 2 \cdot 3 = 3\). Dono tareeqon se ek hi jawab!

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 22 mein agar ghalti se \(\underline{F} \times \underline{r}\) le lete to jawab kya aata? (Jawab: \(-8\underline{i} + 9\underline{j} + 14\underline{k}\), direction ulti magar magnitude wahi \(\sqrt{341}\).)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Adjacent sides \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}\) wale parallelogram ka area \(= |\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|\).
2. Triangle ka area \(= \tfrac12|\underline{u} \times \underline{v}|\), \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}\) ek hi kone se nikalti do sides.
3. \(O\) ke gird \(\underline{F}\) ka moment \(= \underline{r} \times \underline{F}\), \(\underline{r}\) \(O\) se force ki line ke kisi bhi point tak.
4. Moment ki magnitude = force × perpendicular faasla.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Triangle mein \(\tfrac12\) bhool jana: yeh sab se aam ghalti hai.
2. Parallelogram mein saath wali side ki jagah diagonal le lena; pehle check kijiye ke kaun se kone aamne saamne hain.
3. Moment ke liye \(\underline{F} \times \underline{r}\) likh dena: direction ulti ho jati hai.
4. \(\underline{r}\) ulta lena (\(\overrightarrow{AM}\) jab ke chahiye \(\overrightarrow{MA}\)): is se bhi sign ulat jata hai.
